data_tooling.name: build-your-own-x
data_tooling.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
data_tooling.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

data_tooling.summary: Awesome Systematic Trading 是一个系统化交易资源合集，为量化交易者、开发者和研究人员提供一站式学习与工具索引。项目按类别收录数据获取、策略库、回测框架及执行引擎等完整资源，并涵盖经典书籍、专业博客与教程。其高度组织化的结构帮助新手快速构建知识体系，进阶用户可精准定位套利机器人或alpha策略等专业工具。适合用作学习路线图或个人交易系统的搭建起点，通过筛选组合开源库高效实现策略构思到实盘验证。

Its strength lies in comprehensive yet organized coverage, enabling traders and developers to quickly find high-quality tools for backtesting, execution, and research. Users can treat it as a roadmap to explore algorithmic trading, discover new methodologies like arbitrage bots or alpha strategies, and accelerate their learning or project development from a single, vetted source.

data_tooling.name: GeoLibre
data_tooling.summary: GeoLibre 是一款轻量级、云原生的 GIS 平台，旨在让地理空间数据的可视化和分析在任何设备上无缝运行——浏览器、桌面、移动端乃至 Jupyter Notebook 中。它巧妙融合 DuckDB 的高效 SQL 地理查询、MapLibre GL JS 的交互式渲染与 Tauri 的桌面原生性能，无需厚重软件栈即可加载和查询海量 GeoJSON、Shapefile 或 PostGIS 数据。您可通过 npm 或 Docker 快速部署，在 Jupyter 中集成用于可复现的研究，或作为独立应用直接使用。其核心理念是让地理分析轻量化、随处可用，真正降低空间数据探索的门槛。
data_tooling.summary_en: GeoLibre is a lightweight, cloud-native GIS platform that brings geospatial data visualization and analysis to browsers, desktops, mobile devices, and Jupyter notebooks, solving cross-platform spatial exploration challenges. It combines DuckDB's SQL-based geospatial query engine, MapLibre GL JS for interactive rendering, and Tauri for native desktop performance, enabling efficient processing of large datasets without heavy dependencies. You can install via npm or Docker, embed it into Jupyter for reproducible workflows, or run it standalone for quick exploration of GeoJSON, Shapefile, or PostGIS data—making geospatial analysis truly portable and accessible.

data_tooling.name: free-stockdb
data_tooling.summary: free-stockdb 是一个面向 A 股日K、分钟K与ETF分钟数据的本地量化引擎，核心解决云端数据依赖带来的延迟与隐私问题。它通过增量同步机制自动更新本地SQLite数据库，支持复权、批量查询、回测与指标计算，所有操作在本地完成，速度极快且可离线使用。其设计理念是“把数据主权还给用户”，特别适合量化研究员和算法交易者进行快速回测与策略验证。你可以直接使用其MCP接口集成到交易流水线，或fork项目扩展自定义指标，实现低延迟、高可复现的量化研究环境。
data_tooling.summary_en: free-stockdb is a local-first quantitative engine for China A-share daily/minute K-line and ETF minute data. It features incremental sync, local caching, forward/backward adjustment, batch query, backtesting, and indicator computation, all stored locally in SQLite for speed and reliability. Unlike cloud-dependent solutions, it ensures data privacy and offline usability. Ideal for quant researchers and algo traders who need fast, repeatable backtests without network latency. You can fork it, extend with custom indicators, or integrate into your trading pipeline via its MCP interface.

edge_embedded.name: book-to-skill
edge_embedded.summary: book-to-skill 能将任何技术书籍的PDF自动转化为Claude Code技能，解决开发者需要手动提取和整理知识以供编码时参考的痛点。其核心技术是利用大语言模型解析PDF，自动提取关键概念、示例和工作流程，并结构化生成可直接使用的技能文件。操作上，你只需提供一本技术书籍的PDF（如Python或机器学习教材），即可获得一个上下文感知的技能，让Claude Code在你编码时直接调用，从而加速学习、减少上下文切换。这个工具特别适合希望将书本知识快速转化为编程实践辅助的开发者。
edge_embedded.summary_en: book-to-skill automatically converts technical book PDFs into Claude Code skills, solving the problem of manually extracting and organizing knowledge for on-the-job reference. Its technical core uses LLM-based parsing to extract key concepts, examples, and workflows from PDFs, structuring them into actionable skill files. Practically, you can feed any technical PDF—like a Python or ML textbook—and instantly get a context-aware skill that Claude Code can use while you code, accelerating learning and reducing context switching.

agents_workflows.name: ECC
agents_workflows.summary: ECC是一个开源代理框架，专为优化Claude Code、Cursor等AI编码助手性能而设计。它通过注入技能、直觉、记忆和安全机制，使代理更自主高效地完成开发任务。核心技术提供模块化系统，允许开发者将自定义能力和上下文无缝集成到大语言模型代理中，提升输出可靠性与质量。实际应用中，ECC可为编码代理添加持久化记忆和专用技能，使多文件重构、安全审计等复杂工作流更稳健。适用于个人项目或团队协作，帮助打造更智能、安全的AI开发伙伴。
agents_workflows.summary_en: ECC is an open-source agent harness that optimizes performance for AI coding assistants like Claude Code and Cursor. It enhances agents with skills, instincts, memory, and security, enabling more autonomous and efficient development workflows. Technically, it provides a modular framework to inject custom capabilities and context into LLM-based agents, improving their reliability and output quality. Developers can integrate ECC to extend their coding agents with persistent memory and specialized skills, making complex tasks like multi-file refactoring or security audits more robust.

agents_workflows.name: book-to-skill
agents_workflows.summary: book-to-skill 能将任何技术书籍的PDF自动转化为Claude Code技能，解决开发者需要手动提取和整理知识以供编码时参考的痛点。其核心技术是利用大语言模型解析PDF，自动提取关键概念、示例和工作流程，并结构化生成可直接使用的技能文件。操作上，你只需提供一本技术书籍的PDF（如Python或机器学习教材），即可获得一个上下文感知的技能，让Claude Code在你编码时直接调用，从而加速学习、减少上下文切换。这个工具特别适合希望将书本知识快速转化为编程实践辅助的开发者。
agents_workflows.summary_en: book-to-skill automatically converts technical book PDFs into Claude Code skills, solving the problem of manually extracting and organizing knowledge for on-the-job reference. Its technical core uses LLM-based parsing to extract key concepts, examples, and workflows from PDFs, structuring them into actionable skill files. Practically, you can feed any technical PDF—like a Python or ML textbook—and instantly get a context-aware skill that Claude Code can use while you code, accelerating learning and reducing context switching.

agents_workflows.name: speech-to-speech
agents_workflows.summary: 这个由Hugging Face推出的开源项目，让你用本地模型构建语音到语音的智能体，完美解决隐私和延迟痛点。其核心是模块化流水线：将Whisper（语音转文字）、Coqui TTS（文字转语音）和翻译模型无缝衔接，所有处理离线运行。你可以快速创建完全离线的语音助手、实时翻译器或无障碍工具，甚至可以替换任何组件。社区活跃，文档完善，适合隐私敏感或低延迟场景。
agents_workflows.summary_en: speech-to-speech is a Hugging Face framework for building local voice agents with open-source models, addressing privacy and latency concerns. Its key insight is a modular pipeline that combines ASR (e.g., Whisper), TTS (e.g., Coqui), and optional translation, all running offline. You can rapidly prototype privacy-first voice assistants, real-time translators, or accessibility tools without cloud dependencies, and swap components freely. Fully open under Apache-2.0.

framework_core.name: speech-to-speech
framework_core.summary: 这个由Hugging Face推出的开源项目，让你用本地模型构建语音到语音的智能体，完美解决隐私和延迟痛点。其核心是模块化流水线：将Whisper（语音转文字）、Coqui TTS（文字转语音）和翻译模型无缝衔接，所有处理离线运行。你可以快速创建完全离线的语音助手、实时翻译器或无障碍工具，甚至可以替换任何组件。社区活跃，文档完善，适合隐私敏感或低延迟场景。
framework_core.summary_en: speech-to-speech is a Hugging Face framework for building local voice agents with open-source models, addressing privacy and latency concerns. Its key insight is a modular pipeline that combines ASR (e.g., Whisper), TTS (e.g., Coqui), and optional translation, all running offline. You can rapidly prototype privacy-first voice assistants, real-time translators, or accessibility tools without cloud dependencies, and swap components freely. Fully open under Apache-2.0.

framework_core.name: free-stockdb
framework_core.summary: free-stockdb 是一个面向 A 股日K、分钟K与ETF分钟数据的本地量化引擎，核心解决云端数据依赖带来的延迟与隐私问题。它通过增量同步机制自动更新本地SQLite数据库，支持复权、批量查询、回测与指标计算，所有操作在本地完成，速度极快且可离线使用。其设计理念是“把数据主权还给用户”，特别适合量化研究员和算法交易者进行快速回测与策略验证。你可以直接使用其MCP接口集成到交易流水线，或fork项目扩展自定义指标，实现低延迟、高可复现的量化研究环境。
framework_core.summary_en: free-stockdb is a local-first quantitative engine for China A-share daily/minute K-line and ETF minute data. It features incremental sync, local caching, forward/backward adjustment, batch query, backtesting, and indicator computation, all stored locally in SQLite for speed and reliability. Unlike cloud-dependent solutions, it ensures data privacy and offline usability. Ideal for quant researchers and algo traders who need fast, repeatable backtests without network latency. You can fork it, extend with custom indicators, or integrate into your trading pipeline via its MCP interface.
